# Compliance365

> Australian compliance consultancy delivering ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, Essential Eight, SOC 2, DISP, and NIST CSF using Microsoft 365 — typically certifying in 10–16 weeks.

Compliance365 is a Brisbane-based consultancy helping mid-market and growth-stage Australian organisations achieve compliance certification using tools they already own. We specialise in Microsoft 365-native implementations (SharePoint, Power Automate, Purview, Defender, Sentinel) so organisations get audit-ready evidence without purchasing a separate GRC platform. Our engagements are fixed-scope, fast, and lower cost than traditional consulting approaches.

## Services

- [ISO 27001 Certification](https://www.compliance365.com.au/services/iso27001/): Full ISMS implementation and Stage 1/Stage 2 audit support for Australian organisations. Typical timeline: 12–16 weeks.
- [ISO 27701 Privacy](https://www.compliance365.com.au/services/iso27701/): Privacy Information Management System aligned to the Australian Privacy Act 1988. Integrates with ISO 27001.
- [ISO 42001 AI Governance](https://www.compliance365.com.au/services/iso42001/): AI Management System (AIMS) covering model inventory, AI risk assessment, human oversight, and responsible AI policy.
- [Essential Eight](https://www.compliance365.com.au/services/essential-eight/): ASD Essential Eight maturity uplift from baseline to ML2 or ML3. Gap assessment, remediation, and evidence pack included.
- [SOC 2](https://www.compliance365.com.au/services/soc2/): SOC 2 Type I and Type II readiness, evidence architecture, and audit coordination for Australian SaaS companies targeting US enterprise customers.
- [DISP / ISM / IRAP](https://www.compliance365.com.au/services/disp-ism-irap/): Defence Industry Security Program membership, ISM alignment, and IRAP assessment readiness for Australian Defence contractors.
- [NIST CSF 2.0](https://www.compliance365.com.au/services/nist-csf/): NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 implementation with current-state profile, target profile, and measurable roadmap.

## Free Resources

- [ISO 27001 Readiness Checklist](https://www.compliance365.com.au/checklist/iso27001/): Interactive 40-question ISMS assessment with real-time scoring and PDF roadmap download. Free, no sign-up.
- [ISO 27701 Privacy Readiness Checklist](https://www.compliance365.com.au/checklist/iso27701/): 35-question PIMS assessment covering ROPA, DPIA, data rights, and third-party privacy risk. Aligned to the Australian Privacy Act.
- [ISO 42001 AI Governance Checklist](https://www.compliance365.com.au/checklist/iso42001/): 30-question AIMS assessment covering model inventory, AI risk, human oversight, and responsible AI policy.
- [Essential Eight Readiness Checklist](https://www.compliance365.com.au/checklist/essential-eight/): 45-question assessment scored against ASD ML1/ML2/ML3 criteria across all eight controls.
- [Inside a Statement of Applicability](https://www.compliance365.com.au/resources/inside-statement-of-applicability/): Practitioner guide to building an integrated SoA for ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and ISO 42001 in Microsoft 365.
- [What a Good ROPA Looks Like](https://www.compliance365.com.au/resources/what-a-good-ropa-looks-like/): Record of Processing Activities guide with worked examples and common mistakes that trigger regulatory enquiries.
- [AI Governance Readiness](https://www.compliance365.com.au/resources/ai-governance-readiness/): ISO 42001 AIMS implementation guide — model inventory, AI risk, oversight, monitoring, and evidence in Microsoft 365.
- [Automating Compliance in Microsoft 365](https://www.compliance365.com.au/resources/automating-compliance/): How to turn evidence collection, access reviews, and security posture into continuous assurance without a GRC platform.
- [ISO 27001 Cost in Australia (2026)](https://www.compliance365.com.au/resources/iso27001-cost-australia/): Practitioner breakdown of real certification costs for Australian mid-market organisations.
